questions.q: A material that is harder than another…
choices: scratches it, and the reverse is impossible
gets scratched at the same time as it
questions.why: The hardest stone scratches the softest.

questions.q: What is the hardness of quartz on the Mohs scale?
Between corundum (9) and diamond (10), the gap in absolute hardness is…
questions.why: The Mohs scale gives the order, not the gaps: diamond is about three times harder than corundum.

questions.q: Where is a hardness test done?
choices: On a rough stone, or under the base of a cabochon
On the table of a cut stone
On a facet of the crown
On a stone set in a piece of jewellery
questions.why: It is a destructive test: never on a cut gem.

questions.q: With hardness pencils, 6 does not scratch the stone and 7 does. Its hardness is…
questions.why: The first pencil that scratches gives the range.

questions.q: What is the approximate hardness of a fingernail on the Mohs scale?
questions.why: Glass and a knife blade are about 5.5, a steel file 6.5.

questions.q: Why does a gem with a hardness below 7 get scratched little by little?
choices: Because it is always fragile to blows
The dust in the air contains quartz, of hardness 7
questions.why: A stone softer than quartz loses its polish from being worn.

questions.q: Which stone can cut a diamond?
questions.why: Diamond is about three times harder than corundum.
